idea: food app for overweight people with a google sign in

brand.name: Ample
brand.tagline: No shame. No counting. Just better plates in one click.
brand.audience: Busy adults tired of guilt-tripping diet apps who want a friction-free way to plan satisfying, weight-conscious meals.
brand.visualConcept: Warm Hearth: Soft, organic clay and oatmeal tones paired with rich olive green, featuring oversized, friendly typography and zero-friction Google-only entry portals.
brand.layout: A single-scroll landing page starting with a massive, warm hero section featuring a prominent 'Sign in with Google' button, followed by a side-by-side comparison of 'The Guilt Cycle' vs 'The Ample Way', ending with a clean, interactive meal-builder preview.
creativeNotes: Implement a seamless, single-tap Google Sign-In button that immediately transitions the hero section into a personalized dashboard mockup without page reload.
Use fluid, organic SVG shapes and micro-interactions on food cards to make selection feel tactile and satisfying rather than clinical.
Ensure AAA accessibility contrast ratios on all text elements, prioritizing large, highly-readable serif headings for a premium, editorial feel.

mvp.name: Ample
mvp.headline: No shame. No counting. Just better plates in one click.
mvp.subheadline: Skip the tracking. Gather around a warmer way to eat. Build your perfect plate in one click with a nourishing, stress-free meal planner designed for satisfying, hearth-cooked volume without the psychological toll of calorie tracking.

googleCapabilities.label: Satiety-First Plate Generator
googleCapabilities.rationale: Generates personalized, shame-free plate compositions and visual portion guides based on current hunger levels and cravings, eliminating calorie counting.

config.assistantRole: An empathetic, nourishing culinary guide that builds satisfying, balanced plates focusing on volume, protein, and fiber, evoking the warmth and comfort of a home-cooked, nourishing red-hearth kitchen without mentioning calories or macros.
